hypotheses.statement: Deadlock in Snowflake table DW.FACT_SALES caused the nightly ETL workflow to fail, leading to stale data and latency spikes.

impacts.reason: Deadlock in DW.FACT_SALES caused the ETL workflow to fail, preventing data load into the EDW
Stale data in downstream reporting schema due to failed ETL load

action_plan.rationale: The deadlock caused the ETL workflow to fail. Rerunning the workflow will process the stuck batch and resume normal data flow.
action_plan.expected_outcome: ETL workflow completes successfully, data is loaded into DW.FACT_SALES, and downstream reporting data is refreshed.
